title: Melee Animosity
summary: Melee Animosity is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that causes normal melee hits to increase the Critical Chance of the next Heavy Attack up to a certain amount.
extract:
Melee Animosity is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that causes normal melee hits to increase the Critical Chance of the next Heavy Attack up to a certain amount. 

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing The Fragmented on Effervo, Deimos.
Awarded for killing Whispers in Albrecht's Laboratories missions.
Awarded for killing Gruzzlings in non-Disruption Albrecht's Laboratories mission.
Can be bought from Bird 3 of  Cavia for  7,500, requiring Rank 4 - Scholar.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Critical Chance bonus is additive to mods like  True Steel.
Only provides 1 stack per melee input, regardless of how many enemies are hit.
At all ranks, it requires 10 hits to reach the maximum critical chance bonus listed.
Only consumes stacks if the heavy attack connects with an enemy. Whiffing a heavy attack will preserve the critical chance bonus.
The bonus only procs on normal melee attacks. Slams and heavy attacks do not.

Bugs
Glaive (Weapon Type) throws count as heavy attacks, ground throws will benefit from the bonus but will not consume stacks.
Same applies to explosions that do not use the heavy attack input (e.g.  Volatile Rebound).
